name: 50 EMA plus RSI/Bollinger breakout with ATR trail
author: shorty_mcshort
indicators: EMA(50); RSI with Bollinger bands; ATR (period unspecified)
entry_long: If today low is above EMA(50) and RSI is below its lower Bollinger Band, buy when price takes out previous day high; skip if price gaps above trigger.
entry_short: If today high is below EMA(50) and RSI is above its upper Bollinger Band, short on break of previous day low; skip gap-through.
exit: Initial stop 1.5*ATR; at +1 ATR move stop to breakeven and trail at 3-bar low/high.
position_sizing: See implementation notes; no uniform size rule.
implementation_notes: Forum member description; RSI band parameters and ATR period omitted.
